% supplementary-material.tex - driver for the Supplementary Materials PDF
%
% Standard LaTeX (article class + generally-available packages) only.

\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[round]{natbib}
\usepackage{alltt}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Stata console transcript typesetting
%
% content.tex \input{}s files generated by Stata's sjlog command, which use
% a handful of typesetting macros for Stata output: \stcmd for inline code,
% and a set of box-drawing macros
% (\HLI/\VBAR/\PLUS/\TOPT/\BOTT/\TLC/\TRC/\BLC/\BRC/\LFTT/\RGTT) that
% reproduce the ASCII tables Stata prints (e.g., regression output). The
% definitions below are a minimal, self-contained implementation covering
% only what this document uses, built from core LaTeX/TeX primitives.
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

\newcommand{\stcmd}[1]{\texttt{#1}}
\newcommand{\bftt}[1]{{\ttfamily\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\sltt}[1]{{\ttfamily\slshape #1}}
\newcommand{\tytilde}{\texttt{\textasciitilde}}
\newcommand{\lbr}{\texttt{\char`\{}}
\newcommand{\rbr}{\texttt{\char`\}}}

% Box-drawing characters, each occupying one monospace character cell so
% that ASCII-art tables line up under the alltt environment used below.
% (\makeatletter is needed because these internal names use "@".)
\makeatletter
\newlength{\st@xwidth}
\newlength{\st@maxheight}
\newlength{\st@linesize}
\newlength{\st@maxdepth}
\newlength{\st@mtdepth}
\newlength{\st@mbdepth}
\newlength{\st@emptywidth}
\newbox{\st@box}
\newcount\st@N
\def\st@setup{%
  \setbox\st@box\hbox{\texttt{x}}\global\st@xwidth=\wd\st@box
  \setbox\st@box\hbox{\texttt{[]|}}\global\st@maxheight=\ht\st@box
  \global\st@linesize=0.1\st@xwidth
  \global\st@mbdepth=0.5\st@maxheight
  \global\advance\st@mbdepth by 0.5\st@linesize
  \global\st@mtdepth=\st@mbdepth
  \global\advance\st@mtdepth by \st@linesize
  \global\st@maxdepth=\baselineskip
  \global\advance\st@maxdepth by -\st@maxheight
  \global\st@emptywidth=0.5\st@xwidth
  \global\advance\st@emptywidth by -0.5\st@linesize
}
\def\CDOT{{\hskip0pt\kern\st@emptywidth
  \vrule width\st@linesize height\st@mtdepth depth-\st@mbdepth
  \kern\st@emptywidth}}
\def\DASH{{\vrule width\st@xwidth height\st@mtdepth depth-\st@mbdepth}}
\newcommand{\HLI}[1]{{\st@N=#1 \loop\ifnum\st@N>0 \DASH\advance\st@N by-1\repeat}}
\def\LEFTDASH{{\hskip0pt
  \vrule width\st@emptywidth height\st@mtdepth depth-\st@mbdepth
  \kern\st@emptywidth\hskip0pt\kern\st@linesize}}
\def\RIGHTDASH{{\hskip0pt\kern\st@emptywidth\hskip0pt\kern\st@linesize
  \vrule width\st@emptywidth height\st@mtdepth depth-\st@mbdepth}}
\newcommand{\VBAR}{{\hskip0pt\kern\st@emptywidth
  \vrule width\st@linesize height\st@maxheight depth\st@maxdepth
  \kern\st@emptywidth}}
\def\UPVBAR{{\hskip0pt\kern\st@emptywidth
  \vrule width\st@linesize height\st@maxheight depth-\st@mtdepth
  \kern\st@emptywidth}}
\def\DOWNVBAR{{\hskip0pt\kern\st@emptywidth
  \vrule width\st@linesize height\st@mbdepth depth\st@maxdepth
  \kern\st@emptywidth}}
\newcommand{\PLUS}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\DASH}\VBAR}}
\newcommand{\TOPT}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\DASH}\DOWNVBAR}}
\newcommand{\BOTT}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\DASH}\UPVBAR}}
\newcommand{\LFTT}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\VBAR}\RIGHTDASH}}
\newcommand{\RGTT}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\VBAR}\LEFTDASH}}
\newcommand{\TLC}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\RIGHTDASH}\rlap{\DOWNVBAR}\CDOT}}
\newcommand{\TRC}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\DOWNVBAR}\rlap{\LEFTDASH}\CDOT}}
\newcommand{\BLC}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\UPVBAR}\rlap{\RIGHTDASH}\CDOT}}
\newcommand{\BRC}{{\hskip0pt\rlap{\LEFTDASH}\rlap{\UPVBAR}\CDOT}}

% Environment wrapping a Stata console transcript (\input from a
% code_example_*.log.tex / example_data_*.log.tex file). \smallskip and
% \nullskip are tightened locally to match the spacing sjlog assumes
% between transcript lines.
\newenvironment{stlog}{%
  \par\nobreak\vskip\baselineskip
  \begingroup
  \parindent0pt\parskip0pt
  \fontsize{8}{9}\selectfont
  \st@setup
  \def\smallskip{\vskip-6pt}%
  \def\nullskip{\vskip-\baselineskip}%
  \begin{alltt}
}{%
  \end{alltt}
  \endgroup
  \vspace{0.25em}
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}

\input{content}

\clearpage
\end{document}
% END: supplementary-material.tex
